executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $212.31 per resident day (39.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 8.9% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $313,222, 3.2% of the $9,871,314 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,593,061, $34.26 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $779,159 (48.9%), allocated fringe $247,010 (15.5%), non-wage costs $566,892 (35.6%). Raw food was $484,711 ($10.43 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $15,882.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $875,096, $18.82 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $607,194 (69.4%), allocated fringe $192,494 (22.0%), non-wage costs $75,408 (8.6%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $329,580, $7.09 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $37,551 (11.4%), allocated fringe $11,904 (3.6%), non-wage costs $280,125 (85.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2019, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

limitations: Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075330/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; costs per resident day outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
